{{Quote|There's no star system ''Slave I'' can't reach, and there's no planet I can't find. There's nowhere in the galaxy for you to run. Might as well give up now.|Boba Fett|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''''Slave I''''' was a modified prototype [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] used by famed [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and his [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. It was greatly modified with advanced weapons systems by both Fetts during their respective use.

Originating from [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], the ship was stolen by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], replacing his previous ship, ''[[Jaster's Legacy]]''. After Jango's [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|death]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the ship was inherited by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and used on several missions during and after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was subsequently replaced by the ''[[Slave II]]'', ''[[Slave III]]'', and ''[[Slave IV]]''.

==Description==
{{Quote|Because it flies 'standing up' and lands with its engines down, it takes skill that even a fine pilot must work on, Boba.|Jango, training Boba|<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Slave_I_display.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Cockpit display on ''Slave I'']]
Like all ''Firespray''s, ''Slave I'' sat flat on its bottom surface when idle, although during flight the ship rotated 90 degrees to maneuver vertically. Boba later added a unique stabilization system which always kept the cockpit oriented "up".

''Slave I'' was a well-armed starship, and to keep it from becoming obsolete, it was endlessly modified. It was stolen during the [[Komari Vosa|Vosa]] [[The Hunt|bounty]], near the time of the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the end of Jango's life. While under Jango Fett's ownership, its weaponry included two heavy twin [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons, as well as two rapid firing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Rounding out the ship's armament were two projectile launchers, each holding a magazine of three [[Homing missile/Legends|homing missiles]] or various other payloads, and a naval [[Minelayer (weapon system)|minelayer]] equipped with [[Seismic charge/Legends|seismic charges]].

''Slave I'' also possessed special dummy [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] mounted with [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] and S-thread trackers. By tagging a ship with one of these beacons, Fett could then utilize his contraband [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver to track ships through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Most of these weapons were hidden beneath the hull; the armor plating would slide away during the ship's attacks. The ship was also outfitted with a sensor array that could detect minute changes in the ship's mass, which could be used to find homing beacons.<ref name="EOE">''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire]]''</ref>

Jango added a spartan crew quarters since the original ''Firespray'' was suited for short-term patrols. On top of all this, Jango devoted two-thirds of the entire ship's interior to the powerful upgraded Kuat drive engines and power generators, giving ''Slave I'' the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] &mdash; a remarkable feat for a ship of ''Slave I''{{'s}} size. There was a combination airlock and docking ring behind the cockpit, although this was covered by a sensor dish at various points in the vessel's history.

==History==
===Acquisition===
{{Quote|She's a ''Firespray'' Pursuit Special&hellip;one of six prototypes manufactured for the prison. She's the last of her kind now.|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|audio=LastOfHerKind-SWBH.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:Slave_I.jpg|thumb|180px|''Slave I'' on a [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] landing platform]]</div>
Originally, ''Slave I'' was a prototype police vehicle from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] prison [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. There were only six of the model in [[The galaxy/Legends|the entire galaxy]], all on Oovo IV.

While on the trail for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] leader, [[Komari Vosa]], Jango Fett captured [[Bendix Fust]] for the crime lord [[Sebolto]]. Fett was beaten to Fust in Desolation Alley by another bounty hunter, who then began a prison riot. After fighting his way through armed guards and prisoners, Jango made it back to his ship, ''[[Jaster's Legacy]]''. Unfortunately, the rival bounty hunter attempted to slice into the old ship. After helping [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] defeat a horde of guards, a ''Firespray''-class starship fired upon Jango's ship, destroying it.

Acting on a tip from the elevator manager, Jango made his way into the asteroid prison's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]] and stole a ''Firespray''-class vessel along with Wesell. During their escape, Jango launched two missiles into the hangar bay housing the other five ''Firespray'' vessels and destroyed them to deny any chance of being pursued, leaving his the only ship of its type in existence. Sometime later, Jango would name his new ship ''Slave I''. It was not until [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] reintroduced the ''Firespray'' line several decades later that other examples of the class would again be seen.

===Boba's ''Slave I''===
{{Quote|I've recently made a few adjustments. The only original part of the ship is the chair I'm sitting in.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
[[File:Slave_I_Vanqor.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Slave I'' pursues Mace Windu's Delta-7B interceptor on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]].]]
After Jango's death in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Boba took the ship. ''Slave I'' was stolen in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by [[Gjon]] on [[Bogg 2]], but Boba and a thief named [[Aia]] took it back.<ref name="TFTS">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref> When the boy was captured by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] gave her the ship as a payment, but Boba eventually recovered it.<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref> During this time, Boba landed on Tatooine and had [[Mentis Qinx]] refuel his ship. Over time, he equipped ''Slave I'' with better weapons and systems. He added an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]],<ref name="R2 Come Home" /> [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], and a minelayer.<ref name="Hunted" /> Boba had the ship when he teamed up with [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]], to avenge Jango`s death and kill [[Mace Windu]]. When the attempt failed, Boba used ''Slave I'' to transport hostages [[Ponds/Legends|CC-6454]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] and a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] to Florrum to lure Windu out.<ref name="R2 Come Home" /> At [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] heavily damaged ''Slave I'' with her lightsaber in attempt to rescue the hostages and to prevent Aurra Sing from flying away. Aurra lost her control over ''Slave I'' and crash landed the ship. In the resulting explosion, she was considered dead and ''Slave I'' was counted as destroyed during that time, and young Boba was captured by Jedi Master [[Plo Koon]], and taken to the court.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>

[[File:HondosSlaveI-ANB.png|thumb|right|200px|''Slave I'' painted with Hondo Ohnaka's symbol during his brief ownership]]
The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], after pulling the unconscious Aurra from the wreckage and realizing the uniqueness of the ship, took the crashed ship after she damaged his [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate base]].<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=''Slave I''-alt (damaged)|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipsv12.jpg}}</ref> He rebuilt the ''Slave I'' and painted it green.<ref>{{CN|url=promos/201007_secretcode/index.html|text=Hasbro Star Wars: The Clone Wars Secret Code ('SLAVE' Video)}}</ref> Later, Fett reacquired the ship, but it was damaged in a dogfight with a [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex-class starfighter]], which he believed to be piloted by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and was saved from destruction only by the intervention of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who later repaired the ship.<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>

Fett would continue to use the ship to hunt various bounties during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], such as when he was employed by Darth Vader to retrieve an escaped clone of [[Galen Marek]],<ref name="LucasArts">{{LucasArts|url=games/theforceunleashed2|text=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II''}}</ref> or on his mission to find [[Abal Karda]].<ref name="EOE" /> Fett even used ''Slave I''{{'s}} capsule pickup abilities to escape the ''[[Mingula]]'' after investigating it.<ref name="BFS">[[Boba Fett ½|''Boba Fett'' ½]]</ref>

[[File:Anya_Karu_destroyed.png|thumb|left|180px|''Slave I'' escapes as the ''Anya Karu'' is destroyed]]
Sometime after Boba Fett took over ''Slave I'', he took it to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] to have it re-modified to fit his profession more suitably. The two rapid fire laser cannons were replaced with an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and a concussion missile launcher. A miniature [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projector was added to assist in capturing bounties. A stolen sensor masking and jamming array made the ship invisible to sensors, allowing Fett to enter any planet, even [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], without hassle. He topped the armament off by changing the main ordnance of the projectile launchers to [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. Fett routinely stored a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] aboard to make himself more mobile once on-world, and devoted a piece of the living area to holding cells.

Around two months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], ''Slave I'' was used to ambush [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] starship ''Millennium Falcon'' in the [[Corsair Outback]], although Solo escaped to hyperspace.<ref name="SW 2 (DH)">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>

[[File:Slave1.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The ''Slave I'' on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] at the time of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] capture]]
Fett used the ship to track Han Solo to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in order to collect the bounty placed on Solo by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During his delivery of Han Solo to Jabba, Fett engaged in a dogfight with two [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. [[IG-88C/Legends|IG-88C]] was destroyed the moment Fett emerged from hyperspace when, rather than inquiring about the other hunter's presence, he fired every weapon aboard ''Slave I''. [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]] followed Fett seconds after the destruction of his counterpart and began to pummel Fett's shields with laser fire.

However as the [[IG-2000/Legends|''IG-2000'']] followed Boba into [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] atmosphere, Fett activated his [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial dampers]] shedding his momentum and frying his [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. This move brought the ''IG-2000'' directly into his sights, where he disabled the ship with his ion cannon, pulled it in with a tractor beam and launched a full bank of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] into it.

After his escape from the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], Boba stole the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] from the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], using it to travel undetected. ''Slave I'' was abandoned in Tatooine's orbit, where it was discovered by a Rebel scout patrol. It was left in a shipyard for several years until it was recovered by Boba, during which time he used the ship ''[[Slave II]]''.

This powerful ship nearly met its end during the "reborn" Emperor's attack on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when Boba Fett ambushed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Fett damaged the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], but still continued to chase after it. The ''Falcon'' managed to escape and be repaired, but Fett was still patiently waiting for his quarry to return. Soon enough, Solo appeared, and he demonstrated his new "[[Lightning gun (Ganath)|lightning gun]]," which tore into parts of ''Slave I'', although Fett managed to escape.

[[File:Slave_I_FFG_by_Ben_Zweifel.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Slave I'' firing her blasters]]
It is probable that Fett escaped through ''Slave I''{{'s}} onboard [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The ship was replaced with ''[[Slave III]]''&mdash;the second had already been used and discarded&mdash;which preceded the ''[[Slave IV]]''. However, some time before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], Fett had managed to recover and repair ''Slave I'' and used it once more after he lost ''Slave IV'' on [[Shogun (planet)|Shogun]].

When [[Briika Jeban]] was mortally wounded tackling a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]]&mdash;one of the spikes on the warrior's [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]] piercing her suit's plating&mdash;it was revealed that ''Slave I'' was equipped with an emergency [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. Despite its efforts, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was unable to save Briika.

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], ''Slave I'' had a [[decoy system]], which tricked enemy sensors into detecting a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] instead of a ''Firespray''. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] Fett used ''Slave I'' to bring back [[Sintas Vel]]'s carbonite-frozen body from [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[41 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JangoSlave1cleaned.jpg|thumb|right|180px|''Slave I'' cutaway]]
Some people mistakenly believe the ''Slave I''{{'s}} design was inspired by a lamp post outside the [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] building. But [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], an art director on [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], said that his design for the ''Slave I'' was actually based on a radar dish.<ref name="Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> It was later on when the ship was being constructed at ILM that someone pointed out that it resembled a street lamp, and from then on people just assumed that that had been the original source of the design.<ref name="Star Wars: From Concept to Screen to Collectible">''[[Star Wars: From Concept to Screen to Collectible]]''</ref> [[Lorne Peterson]] was one of only two model makers to work on the ''Slave I''.

Damage to the ''Slave I'' prior to being repainted green by Hondo is shown on the PocketModel ship unit produced by [[WizKids Games|WizKids]]. However, the game piece shows both wings in place and includes stats for ''Slave I'' for starship battles. This indicates that the rebuilding by the Weequay pirate was a work in progress with the functional parts repaired before the cosmetic pieces and the outer hull received attention.<ref name="SWPM" />

[[K. W. Jeter]]'s ''[[Slave Ship]]'' states ''Slave I'' was custom-built for Boba Fett by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]], but later sources overrode this statement. The "construction" was possibly retroactively changed to a refitting. It is mentioned in the books that ''Slave I'' had to be significantly rebuilt following damage done by Bossk and Xizor.

''Slave I'' was severely damaged and almost destroyed in the comic ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''. A number of other sources show Boba Fett using different starships, although he is once again flying a ''Firespray'' in ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''. However, the later works of [[Karen Traviss]] once more have him flying ''Slave I''. It is stated that the captain's chair he sits in and the consoles are among the few original parts of ''Slave I'' from the ship of Jango's time.<ref name="Boba Fett: A Practical Man">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>

Many of ''Slave I''{{'s}} internal structures were changed from ''Episode V'' to ''Episode II'' and the ''Clone Wars'' TV series. The ''[[Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' for the original series depicts ''Slave I''{{'s}} internal structures to be oriented for when the ship is in its horizontal landing position while the same book series for ''Episode II'' depicts the ship with its internal structures oriented for use while the ship is in its vertical flying position. Other discrepancies include the airlock that is seen in [[Death Trap|episode 20]] of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|the second season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] that was previously depicted as a series of antennas and sensors,<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref> and then back to sensors again by the time of ''Episode V''.<ref name="CCS" />

Both the Boba and Jango Fett variations of the ''Slave I'' appeared in ''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike'' as unlockable ships: Boba's version was unlocked by earning bronze medals on all standard single-player missions, whereas Jango's version only appeared in "Versus Mode" when one player picked ''Slave I'' and another picked the Jedi Starfighter for the Geonosis versus mode stage.<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref><ref name="RS guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>
